items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: He'd play it up there with the same girl I'm talking to you about now. Helen Edwards.

ctx.x: They said Buddy Petit was that way.

That's how Buddy Petit lost to Roosevelt. He was in the goal room. Really? I didn't know that. Well, sure. He'd play it up there with the same girl I'm talking to you about now. Helen Edwards. She was the pianist up there in the goal room at the Roosevelt. But that's how he lost that job. Taking two, three deposits. And he would go around and instead of going to the Roosevelt where he was making money, big money, he'd go around to them halls and play where he could get up and dance. You understand? Play two,…
